decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The storage building hereby approved, shall be finished in white render

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted A-15, N/HN/10/1
Received 5th August 2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The storage area to the rear of the site shall remain ancillary to the main retail (A1) use of the premises.
description: Retention of storage building to rear of business premises
